title: Read-only Architecture Studio functional specification
objective: Define a testable, read-only I-006 product and interaction specification that consumes real Graph IR v1 evidence without editing derived facts, leaking X6 types, or duplicating Rust graph calculations.
validations: Specification contract check passed with all required sections, a contiguous set of 24 functional requirements, and a contiguous set of 16 acceptance criteria.
The current real I-004 Graph IR parsed as v1.0.0 with 47 nodes, 43 edges, project/target node kinds, and contains/depends_on edge kinds, matching the specification's honest starting slice.
The local open-source research link resolves, both new files parse/read successfully, and neither contains trailing whitespace.
Repository coordination validation passed with 19 task records through the repository .venv.
git diff --check passed; only pre-existing line-ending and inaccessible global-ignore warnings appeared for unrelated working-tree files.
Scoped status and path review confirmed that this task created only its task record and specification and did not edit or regenerate any I-004 implementation path.
risks: The real I-004 Graph IR slice currently contains Nx projects and targets only; task, agent, handoff, ADR, test, and run views require later extractor inputs and must not be claimed by I-006 v1.
Node inspection requires a controlled Grafting-owned read-only selection contract in x6-canvas; any implementation change must update its public API baseline and behavioral contracts.
Reusable filtering, subgraph selection, ordering, and layout calculations must remain Rust-owned and use batched boundaries rather than a TypeScript reimplementation.

I-004 completed while this specification was being authored; its real output was inspected read-only, and future I-006 implementation must consume the reviewed contract without rewriting extractor authority in the app.
